scope_fields.title: Analytic complexity of ordinal colored dense order preorders
accepted_claims: Exact empty and singleton Borel degrees.
For every countable alpha >= 2, analytic-complete non-Borel relation as a set and a fixed analytic-complete upward section, under the conventional continuous Baire-space reductions.
The singleton least class and the local-cofinal-tail characterization of the greatest class.
Sigma^0_3 upper bound for the greatest class and the stated constant-color and finite-support comparisons.
remaining_target_gaps: Exact Borel preorder degrees for alpha >= 2.
Strictness or reversibility of inclusion reductions among nontrivial ordinals.
Universality or nonuniversality as analytic preorders.
Classification of mutual embeddability equivalence relations.

scope.color_order: The usual order of every countable ordinal, with the discrete product coding alpha^Q.
scope.witness: Strictly increasing rational maps with image dense in its convex hull, equivalently restrictions of continuous increasing real embeddings preserving rational arguments. Neither onto Q nor density in all of R is required.
scope.set_completeness: Continuous many-one reductions from analytic subsets of Baire space, equivalently zero-dimensional Polish source spaces. Not arbitrary connected Polish source spaces.
scope.relation_reductions: Borel preorder reducibility uses one map preserving and reflecting all ordered pairs; set completeness does not establish preorder universality.
scope.greatest_class: Every ordinal tail is dense on one common nonempty interval; Sigma^0_3 is an upper bound, not a completeness assertion.

scope_fields.question_credit: Riccardo Camerlo, Universal analytic preorders, Oberwolfach Report 55/2005, printed pp. 3127–3129, Problem 5 on p. 3128.
